purpose: Provenance-first attribution of Fold 4 zero Winner output and the observed Winner concentration, without modifying the locked 42 records.

frozen_protocol.candidate_eligibility_rule: decision is LONG or SHORT AND risk decision is ALLOW_SIGNAL
frozen_protocol.winner_selection_rule: direct threshold split of eligible/evaluated rows; no ranking or second-stage winner filter

fold4_attribution.construction_explanation: NOT THE CAUSE: Fold 4 contains its full 400-observation test slice and 121 eligible/evaluated records.
fold4_attribution.threshold_explanation: CONFIRMED: all 121 eligible/evaluated records were controls (gross_return <= 0.0014), so none entered the Winner population.

winner_concentration_attribution.attribution_level_1: CONSTRUCTION_NOT_PRIMARY_CAUSE: every fold has a fixed 400-observation slice; Fold 1 has 137 eligible/evaluated records, not a special fold size.
winner_concentration_attribution.attribution_level_2: THRESHOLD_SELECTION_IS_THE_DIRECT_DOWNSTREAM_GATE: the 28 Winner records are produced by gross_return > 0.0014 from the eligible/evaluated rows.
winner_concentration_attribution.attribution_level_3: UPSTREAM_CAUSE_OF_THE_9_RECORD_CELL_REMAINS_UNRESOLVED: the locked full-population artifact does not expose a fold x direction x regime cross-tab for all 999 controls, so it cannot prove whether the 9/14 Fold-1 winners reflect candidate-base composition, strategy signal composition, or outcome concentration.

evidence_boundary.next_authorized_scope: Only source-level reconstruction of the Fold-4 eligible/control distribution and the full candidate-base direction/regime cross-tab may reduce the remaining attribution uncertainty.
